svg.text: A258 -- the NORMAL RING: a pinwheel of four common-tilt pairs, parameters (a_w, phi_w), and its domain D
(a) the TIGHT C4 normal ring at s-hat, phi = 14.545 deg
Q1
Q2
F
IS: a = (K cos - 1)/(cos - sin), b = K - a: all four corners in contact (a
sin + b cos = 1); geometry check: containment 0.0e+00, least pair gap
grey: the SEALED triangle under the row (legs 1, tan phi). F: the seated
poker, vertex at the tooth apex
(a + sec, cos); Hall minimum of the nine = 1. Stipple: the floor's
ribbon.
(b) C4 slice of D at s-hat: phi (across, 0..45 deg) vs a (up, 0..1)
IS: the set {(phi, a): (a, a, a, a; phi, phi, phi, phi) in D} at s-hat,
exact closed forms (family258.md).
blue: in D; purple: in D AND the tooth reaches the ribbon (a seated poker
exists); black: D_tight.
White is NOT "excluded": it is outside the family; the classification
claim is NORMAL-RING [C].
